name: Volunteer at White Oak Medical Center
org: Adventist HealthCare White Oak Medical Center
what_you_do: Help at a hospital in Silver Spring. Volunteers work in the gift shop and at information desks, visit patients, help on nursing units, and do office tasks.
who_can_apply: Volunteers ages 15 and older. The page lists no residency rule.
deadline_text: Last read Oct 19, 2026: the page said the hospital was not taking volunteer applications and to check back. No reopening date was posted.
how_to_apply: Check the page for when applications open again. You will need shot records (MMR, chickenpox, Tdap, Hep B, flu, and COVID-19), a 4 hour orientation, a meeting with your supervisor, and a background check.
notes: Confirm first. The site blocked automated reading on Nov 4, 2026, so details are from Oct 19, 2026. The hospital's Stepping Stones shadowing program needs two years of college, so it is not for high schoolers. Adventist HealthCare main line: 301-315-3030.
